hints.text: Your DCs are linked through land. A link is only as strong as its weakest cell.

T has a bug. It is protected only if its link is stronger than the bug, and the 1 next to T makes it too weak. Select S and step right twice: Auto carries power through without stripping the cells it passes.
Protected. T keeps producing and nothing drains. Bugs grow, so keep corridors at the safe level.
The bug is curable now. Send at least its health into T from the cell next to it.
Cured. Strong corridors buy you time; cures finish the job.
